claims.claim: You must contact an approved debt adviser to apply for a Debt Relief Order.
claims.quote: Contact an approved debt adviser to apply for a DRO . You cannot apply for a DRO on your own.
claims.note: The Debt Relief Order page explicitly directs applicants to an approved adviser.

claims.claim: The approved debt adviser submits the Debt Relief Order application for you.
claims.quote: Contact an approved debt adviser to apply for a DRO . You cannot apply for a DRO on your own.
claims.note: The page requires an approved adviser and rules out applying alone, but it does not explicitly say the adviser submits the application.
